title: WorkflowStateSnapshot
description: Persisted run state. Validated against persisted snapshots in contract tests so the invariants below are machine-enforced rather than documented. v2.0.0 (CR-013) replaces integer stage identity with instance-keyed node identity, because the previous fixed twelve-element array could not represent S7's per-task fan-out (FR-ORC-003). v3.0.0 (CR-029) removes the run-level ai flag: orchestration always uses AI (ADR-004-A2), so there is no mode to record. What ran is recorded per node in executorKindUsed.

terminalState.description: Terminal set is exactly these three. SAFE_STOP is suspended and NON-terminal (CL-005).

policySetVersion.description: The policy version this run evaluated (Constitution VI).

lastActivityAt.description: Drives the idle clock. Never creation time — a run that received attention must not be reaped on age.

nodes.description: Execution nodes, not stages. A freshly materialised run holds thirteen: eleven SINGLETON stages, the S7 FAN_OUT_PARENT, and its JOIN. FAN_OUT_CHILD nodes are appended when the preceding stage yields tasks, so there is no upper bound (FR-ORC-003). nodeKey uniqueness and the join invariant are asserted by T074's test — JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by property.

nodeKey.description: Node identity. "S1".."S12" for a singleton or fan-out parent; "S7.1".."S7.n" for a fan-out child; "S7.join" for its join node. Unique per run.

stageNumber.description: The stage this node belongs to. A STORED value, never derived by parsing nodeKey — T074 asserts the column wins when the two deliberately disagree.

parentNodeKey.description: Set on FAN_OUT_CHILD and JOIN nodes; null on SINGLETON and FAN_OUT_PARENT.

executorKindUsed.description: Executor kind actually used. HUMAN is recorded for a node the human implemented under the no-plan gate (FR-ORC-031); it is never flag-selectable. Required on every executed node (FR-ORC-029).

allOf.description: A FAN_OUT_CHILD or JOIN node names its parent; a SINGLETON or FAN_OUT_PARENT does not.

edges.description: Declared dependencies. Edges are explicit, never inferred from call order (FR-ORC-002). Acyclic — validated before any replanned subgraph is committed (EC-030).

joinSemantics.description: ALL means the join does not proceed while any required branch is incomplete or failed (EC-018).

invalidatedNodes.description: Node keys invalidated by the replan. Node-level, not stage-level: a replan may invalidate one fan-out child and leave its siblings intact (FR-ORC-019, ADR-009).

voidedApprovals.description: Decision IDs voided by superseding record, never deleted (EC-020).

allOf.description: terminalState is non-null iff state is terminal.
autoAbandonAt and suspensionReason are non-null iff suspended.
